palette.name: 冷茶棕
palette.spec: LOW-to-MEDIUM value cool neutral tea BROWN. The dominant color must remain deep muted brown with olive/ash neutral highlights; visibly reduce the current reddish-orange warmth. Not pure black, silver, green or a global blue filter. Deep coffee shadows, fine subdued cool-brown highlight strands.
palette.summary: 低明度冷棕，压低明显红橙反光。
palette.region: XHS31九格图中排左侧明确标“冷茶棕”
palette.care: 染发视觉参考；实际提浅方式按底色确认。

palette.name: 巧克力棕
palette.spec: DEEP neutral-warm CHOCOLATE BROWN. Rich dark cocoa base with visible warm milk-chocolate/cacao glints on lit strands. Clearly warmer and more cocoa-brown than the cool-tea sample, but NOT chestnut copper, red, pure black or golden blonde. Maintain dimensional darker roots and strand shadows.
palette.summary: 深可可棕，带克制的暖棕光泽。
palette.region: XHS34第1张巧克力棕自拍，XHS31右上摩卡棕作辅助
palette.care: 染发视觉参考；深浅与持色以现场确认为准。

palette.name: 栗棕
palette.spec: MEDIUM value WARM CHESTNUT BROWN. Clearly visible gentle copper-red and reddish caramel reflections throughout brown hair, lighter and warmer than dark chocolate. Natural chestnut-brown body, not vivid orange, not fire red, not blonde. Preserve shadows, texture, roots and plausible strand variation.
palette.summary: 中等暖栗棕，红铜反光更明显。
palette.region: XHS29第1张为染后约一个月栗棕，不当作刚染完色卡
palette.care: 暖调变化较明显；掉色与后续维护待确认。

palette.name: 榛果灰棕
palette.spec: MEDIUM value HAZELNUT ASH BROWN with muted gray-beige taupe highlights. Noticeably cooler, smokier and more desaturated than chestnut/chocolate, visibly lighter than deep cool tea. Brown remains the body color, with mushroom/taupe ash in the light. Do not make it silver, white, flat gray paint or blue. Keep natural darker strand shadows.
palette.summary: 中等明度灰褐棕，冷灰米感更清楚。
palette.region: XHS26正文明确榛果灰棕；LIVE-HARDY完整正文再次核对该名称
palette.care: 灰感与明度受原底色影响，需确认维护方式。

palette.name: 奶茶棕
palette.spec: LIGHT-to-MEDIUM value MILK TEA BEIGE BROWN, clearly lighter than all deep brown and chestnut variants. Soft low-saturation latte/caramel beige with muted beige-gold on highlight strands, balanced taupe-brown shadows and slightly deeper natural roots. Warm-neutral creamy light brown, not orange, yellow blonde, platinum or gray. Hair color only: skin and backdrop must not become brighter.
palette.summary: 明度更高的米褐奶茶色，变化更醒目。
palette.region: XHS31九格下排中间、XHS32首图上排第二格均明确标“奶茶棕”
palette.care: 较浅效果；是否需要提浅或漂发须现场确认。

palette.name: 黑加仑紫棕
palette.spec: DEEP GRAPE / BLACKCURRANT PURPLE-BROWN. A dark aubergine-brown base with distinctly visible muted berry-purple and plum reflections on lit strands, similar to low-saturation blackcurrant hair outdoors. Must visibly read as purple-brown rather than ordinary warm chestnut. Not neon purple, not pink, not burgundy red only. Retain deep brown/purple shadows and realistic fine strands. Purple affects scalp hair only, never skin, glasses, eyebrows, lips or background.
palette.summary: 深褐底带莓紫反光，属于个性探索。
palette.region: XHS33第1张为紫色目标；第2张为染前，不作目标
palette.care: 个性发色参考；原底色、褪色与维护待确认。
